svg.title: Preemptive vs Non-preemptive scheduling
svg.desc: Two Gantt-chart-style timelines showing how preemptive and non-preemptive schedulers handle P1, P2, P3 — followed by a trade-off comparison table.
svg.text: P1 finish, block বা yield না করা পর্যন্ত CPU ধরে রাখে
Shorter/equal job এলে SRTF tie-break policy preempt করতে পারে
